subject: Mutual action plan & close schedule — hosting mode and region recommendation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Isaac Green <isaac.green@acerahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan & close schedule — hosting mode and region recommendation

Isaac — thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual action plan to land AceraHealth on Redwood for inference (attached). The two remaining decision items we heard from you: 1) hosting mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and 2) deployment region.

High level proposal (see attached MAP spreadsheet for milestones):
- Recommended path: start on Dedicated capacity in US-East (predictable throughput + isolated pool) with canary traffic on Hosted for non-PII workloads. Dedicated gives your SREs the most predictable latency and capacity for the primary clinical transcript pipeline.
- Evaluation plan: 2-week PoC (functional tests + 1M token/day load test), followed by a 4-week parallel validation in production with circuit-breaker routing.
- Close timeline: procurement PO by 2026-11-25, target cutover for primary traffic 2026-12-15.

Key asks from Acera: procurement lead & PO cadence, minimum acceptance KPIs (p95 latency < 250ms for 512 tokens, token cost target), and confirm any data zoning constraints requiring Private/VPC.

I've attached the MAP and a short latency matrix we ran across regions. Can we sync Weds 11/4 to finalize procurement timing?

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-Acera_20261102.xlsx (spreadsheet), latency-matrix-us-east-west.pdf (PDF)

From: Isaac Green <isaac.green@acerahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: AceraHealth Procurement <procurement@acerahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & close schedule — hosting mode and region recommendation

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan and timeline. A few quick points from procurement and platform: 
1) Procurement: PO timeline is tight but doable if we sign commercial terms this week. Procurement needs an SOW/Exhibit that spells out capacity commitments and an invoice schedule.
2) Security/data zoning: our compliance team flagged that clinical notes with PHI should be in our VPC or a dedicated tenant. That makes "Dedicated" appealing, but we need clarity on data residency (must be in us-east region).
3) Evaluation: can you confirm whether a short private deployment (VPC) for the 2-week PoC is possible, or will Dedicated with VPC-style isolation work? Also, estimated monthly commit for Dedicated to match the PoC load?

If we can get Exhibit + pricing bundle today, procurement will try to get a PO by 11/24. Weds 11/4 at 10am ET works for a sync.

—Isaac
Isaac Green
Director, Platform Engineering
AceraHealth

(Procurement contact: procurement@acerahealth.com)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Isaac Green <isaac.green@acerahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, AceraHealth Procurement <procurement@acerahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & close schedule — hosting mode and region recommendation

Isaac — good questions. Short answers: 
- Dedicated supports tenant isolation and will meet your residency requirement if you choose a US-East placement; we can carve a dedicated GPU pool bound to your account and region.
- Private (VPC) is available but is a heavier lift for a short PoC; it usually takes additional networking review and SSO/KMS setup that could push the PoC start by 2–3 weeks. Given your PO target, Dedicated + VPC-style data controls (dedicated tenancy + customer-managed KMS) is the pragmatic path to meet the 11/24 PO goal and the 12/15 cutover.
- For the 2-week PoC throughput target (1M token/day peak), the recommended Dedicated commit is 2x the PoC peak to allow headroom and autoscaling — we can model that in the Exhibit. Ballpark monthly commit: $28k–$40k depending on model family and token mix. We'll put exact numbers in the pricing exhibit.

Attached: updated MAP (sheet 2 has procurement milestones) and a short attachment with region latency breakouts.

I'll prepare a short Exhibit and SOW and share before our Wed sync. Lauren will cover SLA and Stephanie will add the operational runbook for cutover.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: MAP-Acera_20261102.xlsx (updated), latency-matrix-us-east-west.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Isaac Green <isaac.green@acerahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & close schedule — hosting mode and region recommendation

Isaac — quick operational note ahead of our call. 

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 08:47 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Dedicated supports tenant isolation and will meet your residency requirement if you choose a US-East placement; we can carve a dedicated GPU pool bound to your account and region.

Two points from the ops side: 
- Canary topology: we'll route 10% of calls for 1 week to Hosted for non-PII inference (lower-cost baseline) and 90% to Dedicated. If the canary passes the QA checks (error rate < .5% and p95 latency within SLA), we'll increase to 50/50 for two weeks before full cutover. This reduces risk and stays within your latency SLO.
- Network egress: if Acera wants strict VPC isolation for all PHI flows, we recommend a Dedicated pool + VPC peering (no on-prem agents). Private/on-prem is possible but will add ~3 weeks to lead time for network and certs.

I've added the canary gating criteria to sheet 3 of the MAP. See my inline notes in the attached runbook.

—Stephanie
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-Acera_20261102.xlsx (sheet 3 runbook), redwood-canary-runbook.pdf

From: Isaac Green <isaac.green@acerahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: AceraHealth Procurement <procurement@acerahealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & close schedule — hosting mode and region recommendation

Thanks all — that allays most concerns. We agree on Dedicated in us-east with the canary plan. A couple of final asks so procurement can lock the PO: 
- Please send the Exhibit and SOW with the Dedicated commit numbers and a 30-day SLA clause (we prefer 99.9% uptime for the Dedicated pool).
- Include a one-time onboarding credit line in the commercial terms (to offset initial validation costs).
- We'll need a DocuSign link for signature; procurement prefers a single PO to reference the signed Exhibit.

If you can send the Exhibit + DocuSign before EOD Thur 11/5, we'll aim to issue the PO by 11/24 and keep the cutover target 12/15. Looking forward to the Wed sync.

—Isaac
Isaac Green
Director, Platform Engineering
AceraHealth
